L6@P0: Abstract. For a given strictly increasing sequence {an} of natural numbers, let g(n) be the number of compositions of n all of whose parts belong
L7@P0: to {an}. We derive a recurrence that enables the computation of g(n), as
L8@P0: well as an estimate for g(n) for large n. We use these results to obtain
L9@P0: useful data concerning compositions whose parts belong to the following 3
L10@P0: sequences: triangular, square, and pentagonal numbers.
L11@P0: 1. Introduction
